Workout of the Week
Aug 11–17, 2026
The M2 Benchmark
Complete all movements for time. This is your benchmark — we run it every 8 weeks so you can track improvement. Scale weights as needed but keep the movements honest.
1km RowFor time
50 Wall Balls9kg / 6kg
500m Ski ErgFor time
25 Burpee Broad JumpsAFAP
1km RunFor time
Coach Dave says: Don't sprint the row — pace it at 85% and save your legs for the burpees. Wall balls will catch you if your breathing isn't controlled going in.

Recovery protocol
1
3 min ice bath — triggers vasoconstriction, flushes metabolic waste
2
10 min sauna — increases blood flow, promotes deep restorative sleep
3
Repeat 2–3 rounds — finish cold for recovery, warm for relaxation
4
Pool on rest days — 20–30 min easy freestyle, active recovery
Research shows regular cold exposure reduces DOMS by up to 20%. 2–3 sessions per week delivers measurable results within 4–6 weeks.
